_comment: Utility Billing Automation, configuration. Replace placeholders with your real values. Secrets (api_key, etc.) should be set via .env / environment variables, NOT committed here.
_note_on_splits: Splits are NOT defined in this config. The script writes raw bill amounts to the spreadsheet, then reads back the spreadsheet's computed Tenant Share row. To change a split, edit the formulas in the spreadsheet itself. The spreadsheet is the single source of truth.

azure_openai._comment: API key and endpoint should be set via environment variables AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY and AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT. Values here are fallbacks only, leave blank in committed config.
azure_openai._deployment_rationale: Matches the live configured Azure deployment. Both LLM tasks have short outputs: a single bill amount and 4-6 sentences of commentary. Provider quality has not been compared in a head-to-head test.

claude_foundry._comment: Optional Claude Hosted on Azure deployment. Credentials come only from ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE. Haiku 4.5 supports the same sampling settings as the Azure baseline.

analysis._comment: Tunable anomaly thresholds. Edit these to taste.

spreadsheet_columns._comment: Column letters in the spreadsheet. Update if you ever rearrange the sheet.

gmail_searches._comment: Each utility maps to a Gmail filter that finds its monthly bill. sender = from: filter. must_contain = arbitrary text that must appear in body/subject (use to disambiguate when you have multiple accounts with the same provider). subject_must_contain = restricted to subject. amount_pattern is a regex fallback used when the selected model client cannot be configured, not after a model NULL or request error.

electricity.notes: Replace sender with your actual electricity provider's billing email.

gas.notes: If you have multiple accounts with the same provider, use must_contain to disambiguate (e.g., last 4 of account number).

internet.notes: Replace with your internet provider's billing email.

garbage.notes: Many waste providers send marketing emails alongside invoice emails. Filter on the invoice-specific sender, not the marketing one.

water_sewer.notes: Many municipal water systems use vendors like InvoiceCloud which send multiple email types (Notification, Reminder, Payment Confirmation). subject_must_contain restricts to the new-invoice notification only.

pet_waste._note: Set _skip: true for any utility you don't actually have. The script will not look for a bill for it.
